evidence: Static: frozen task/tests/test.sh (sha256 bd682592...e5aa) is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/test.sh, and score.py, restart_mcp.py, Dockerfile and scoring.toml are identical too; task.toml differs from the template only in [task]/[metadata] text, and all budgets are unchanged. Against staged-task-contract.md lines 100-111: write_zero_reward runs at line 60 before any grading, and trap cleanup->ensure_reward is set at line 61. No exec. Missing judge env (63-66), missing /app/server.js (68-70) and symlinks outside /app/node_modules (72-83) all exit 0 on the zero record. /app is copied aside (90-95), and the app is launched with setsid env -i (PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH) and setpriv uid 65534 (104-111). Liveness is probed on /api/health then / before RewardKit (115-125). The restart helper is written by heredoc+sed, chmod 755 and exported (127-193). {app_context} is substituted (195-201). The gates suite runs (timeout 1500) and is followed by score.py, where rc 0 continues, rc 1 keeps the detailed record and anything else writes the plain zero (213-222). The scored suite (11100) is followed by score.py, with || write_zero_reward (224-227). Budgets nest: gates 2x600=1200<1500; scored 16x550 (functional individual)+900+900=10600<11100; 1500+11100=12600<13200 verifier. bash -n passes and the file has no CRLF. Instruction/integration.md disclose port 3000, /api/health, the env -i variable set, DB_PATH, a non-/app HOME and cwd, and the no-symlinks rule. Runtime (own container r6row21-sim from the local cw-editor-verifier:current image; frozen tests copied in; real rewardkit replaced by a stub only inside that container; removed afterwards): every scenario exited 0 with a reward. No server.js -> 0.0/no_op; a never-listening app -> 0.0/no_op after ~118 s; an /app/x->/etc/passwd symlink -> 0.0/no_op. A gate failure (render 0) -> graded record, reward 0, gates_passed 0. Malformed gates JSON or a crashed gates RewardKit -> plain zero. A scored RewardKit exit 124 -> graded record, reward 0, gates_passed 1. Functional 0 -> floors_passed 0, reward 0. An out-of-range scored value -> score.py rc 2 -> plain zero. A good run -> reward 0.6 (weights 0.6/0.2/0.2), and the exported APP_RESTART_HELPER restarted the app (ready=1). Hostile app probe: the app ran as uid 65534 with cwd /, DB_PATH=/app/app.db, and its attempt to write /logs/verifier/reward.txt was denied (dir is root 0700). The final reward stayed 0.6000. Plausible broken app passing: none found at this row's level. A 404-on-health app still passes liveness by design (HTTPError counts as up), and the gates judges must then exclude it. Conforming alternative failing: an app that needs more than ~30 s to start would score 0, but the canonical template sets this and the measured probe window was about 118 s. Risk=true because this was a stub-RewardKit control-flow run, not a real configured RewardKit/judge launch. raw-evidence-index.json states that a full configured grading run on these bytes is absent. The 10600 s functional-individual scored budget is also unmeasured (judge.toml comment: 'Not yet measured against a judge run'). An overrun would hit the scored timeout path and give every rollout a graded 0. That is still a written reward, but it is a validity risk that belongs to the workload/launch rows.
run_verdict: EXERCISED (stubbed RewardKit control-flow run in reviewer-owned container; real judge launch NOT EXERCISED)
